practice_observation: The first PR was accepted and then re-opened by the picture assessment, which is why this outcome has two PRs. Measuring wander before choosing the bend, a 2-minute harness for criteria 15, 16 and 22 on the core variant, and the counterfactual restored-share measure kept the rework loops short, and a separate reviewer found what 84 unit and 96 acceptance tests missed (a writhe that breathed at 4.2 Hz, which the worker's own test had pinned as correct, and frozen painted filaments). The costs were visible: three full verification rounds of 26 min on the shared box for PR #69, a box reboot and two usage limits that killed background runs, and criterion 22 run in full only after the id changed for criterion 23, so its failure came late; one scope failure came from verifying on EC-A4's branch copy instead of main. The signal id was selected from scanned candidates and disclosed under R-W2-9, with no criterion or parameter changed; both review records stay on hold for the human look review.
